title: Incorrect use of Response as context manager
detail: The code attempts to use the Response returned by `blueprint.send_static_file` as a context manager. Response objects do not implement `__enter__`/`__exit__`, so this will raise a `TypeError` at runtime.

title: Undefined attribute in wait_ready
detail: The added `wait_ready` method refers to `self.parser`, but the HTTPParser class has no `parser` attribute, causing an AttributeError when called.

title: Undefined attribute in async wait_ready
detail: The async `wait_ready` method incorrectly accesses `self.parser`, which does not exist in HTTPParser, leading to an AttributeError.
